mrIntro: Meseji kubva kuvanhu vari kunze kwevaunosangana navo vanogara pano kusvikira iwe wagamuchira. Mazita uye maID hazvina kusimbiswa; Enzanisa zvigunwe zveminwe usati wavimba nemumwe munhu.
mrPolicy: Yakachengetwa pane ichi chishandiso pane inodzokororwa kwemazuva anosvika 7: 20 vanotumira, 20 mahamvuropu imwe neimwe, 100 yakazara, 2 MiB yakazara (128 KiB pahamvuropu). Mameseji akawandisa uye mafoni asina kukumbirwa anodonhedzwa. Hapana chinhu chinogadziriswa kana kuongororwa chisati chagamuchirwa.
mrFull: Storage limit yakasvika; mameseji matsva akadonha
mrFailed: Haina kukwanisa kugadzirisa zvikumbiro zvemeseji. Ndapota edza zvakare.
daLinked: Zvisati zvamboonekwa zvakabatana mudziyo (midzi siginecha yakasimbiswa)
daSession: Imwe yekumisikidza yakashandisa ichi chiziviso (siginecha yakasimbiswa)
daPush: Imwe yekumisikidza yakazivisa kusundira kunyoreswa (siginecha yakasimbiswa)
daRelayKeys: Relay inoshuma makiyi eakaundi akasiyana kana asipo — kusawirirana kusingazivikanwe

Chitupa chakakopwa kana kusundira kunyoreswa hakugone kubviswa kure pano: dzoreredza pane chiziviso chitsva, zivisa vashandi uye rega kushandisa chitupa chakakanganiswa.
cvReverify: Enzanisa nhamba dzekuchengetedza uye uone zvakare
cvCompare: Enzanisa nhamba iyi pamidziyo miviri. Inosanganisira ese ari maviri encryption uye kusaina makiyi:
cvMissingPin: Kiyi yekusaina yakavharwa inodiwa. Chinja meseji yechokwadi kutanga.
cvMark: Ini ndakaenzanisa ese ari maviri akakosha ekuchengetedza manhamba
cvStrict: Block kutumira mushure mekuchinja kiyi kusvikira yasimbiswazve
cvFailed: Verification failed or keys changed during comparison. Dzokorora uye uenzanise zvakare.
cvBlocked: Kutumira kwakavharwa: makiyi emutauriri akachinja. Enzanisa nhamba dzekuchengetedza uye dzodzokororazve, kana kudzima yakasimba modhi /verify.
vaultNew: Nyowani vault passphrase (angangoita 12 mavara; kwete password yako /lock)
vaultLegacy: /keywrapYakazara nzira kuchinyorwa: Linux Vakapindwa muropa » General » Noticias » Yakazara nzira kuchinyorwa: Linux Vakapindwa muropa » General » Noticias »
vaultScope: Chengetedza makiyi, mameseji / mafaera, vanobatana, zvinyorwa uye zvakavanzika browser marongero eakaundi ese? Chengetedza yako yekudzoreredza mutsara uye vault faira backup kutanga. Theme, mutauro uye mvumo zvinoramba zviri pachena. /vault kukiya kuvhara tebhu yega yega; /vault password inoshandura passphrase.
vaultDisable: Kudzima vault yeakaundi yega yega? Kusimbiswa kunodiwa. Nhoroondo, mafaera, vanobatana, makiyi, madhirowa uye yakavanzika browser marongero anodzokera kune vault-off yekuchengetedza.
vaultFailed: Vault oparesheni yakakundikana. Tarisa pane iyo passphrase uye kuchengetedza; hapana plaintext fallback inobvumidzwa.
vaultRecovery: Iyi haisi password /lock. Kana ukakanganwa, dzoreredza kuzivikanwa kwako uchishandisa yako yekudzoreredza mutsara pane nyowani yekuisa. Zvikamu zviripo zvevault hazvigone kudzoreredzwa pasina iyi passphrase.
vaultOldTabs: Vhara mabhenefiti ekare eBreeze usati wachinja vault.
vaultBackupOnly: Nepo vault ichigoneswa, kunze kwenyika kunongova neyakavharidzirwa vault snapshots. Attachment kurodha pasi, gore, otomatiki uye kudzoreredza-kit kunze kwenyika kwakaremara.
opScope: Kuchinjana kuzivikanwa uku kunokoka nzira mbiri mumunhu. Ivo vanopera mukati memaminitsi e30. Enzanisa zvigunwe zveminwe pane zvese zvishandiso uye simbisa chete kana zvichienderana. Chengeta iyi app yakavhurika kusvikira /rendezvous yapera; Reloading cancels pending pairing. Hapana alias kutarisa kana kudzokorora kuongorora.
opMatches: Ndakaenzanisa zvishandiso zvese zviri zviviri: zvigunwe zveminwe zvinowirirana
opCompare: Enzanisa chigunwe ichi pamidziyo miviri. Inosunga makiyi ese ari maviri, kusaina makiyi uye kukoka nonces.
opConfirmed: Contact verified. Vhura chat yako uye shandura /rendezvous kodhi. Kutumira mameseji kunovhura mushure mekusimbiswa kwekiyi yakavharirwa.
opInvalid: Offline pairing yakakundikana: isina kukodzera, yakapera, yakashandiswa kana isina kuenzana kodhi / kiyi, kana isina kutsigirwa cryptography. Dzima kumirira pairing uye kuchinjana kukoka kutsva.
opPending: Pedzisa offline pairing ne /rendezvous usati watuma. Shandisa /offlinepair kukanzura kukanzura.
opCancelled: Pending offline pairing canceled. Chinja zvikumbiro zvitsva pamidziyo miviri kuti uedze.
rvScope: Inoda chikamu chakavharidzirwa kana kusimbiswa /offlinepair kukokwa. Chinja makodhi ekubatanidza pachivande neQR kana kopi / kunamatira; Ivo vanopera mukati memaminitsi e10.
rvQRTooLarge: Iyi kodhi yakakura kwazvo kune imwe QR. Shandisa kopi / kunamatira pachinzvimbo.
rvScanUnavailable: Kamera QR scanning haiwanikwe mune ino browser. Shandisa kopi / kunamatira pachinzvimbo.
rvReady: Code yakagadzirira / yakashandiswa. Tevedzera kune vezera rako, kana kunamatira mhinduro yavo.
rvCopyFallback: Kopi haiwanikwe. Sarudza uye kopi iyo kodhi nemaoko.
rvTrust: Batanidza kamwe chete kuburikidza nerelay uye uone kutaurirana uku, kana kupedzisa /offlinepair kutanga. A pinned kusaina kiyi uye chikamu kana yakasimbiswa yakamirira pairing inodiwa.
rvInvalid: Isina kukodzera yekubatanidza kodhi kana nhanho isiriyo yekutsinhana.
rvExpired: Iyi kodhi yekubatanidza yapera. Gadzira imwe itsva.
rvTimeout: Nguva yechando yakapera. Ndokumbirawo udzorerezve chibvumirano chako.
rvCandidates: Hapana anoshandiswa ICE vakwikwidzi pasi pezvirongwa zvako zvekuvanzika. Tarisa yako network / TURN marongero uye dzokorora kuchinjana.
rvRedo: Manual connection inoda kudzoreredzwa. Dzokorora /rendezvous nevezera rako.
heroDesc: Hapana nhamba yefoni. Hapana email. Hapana App Store. Vhura chinongedzo, tanga kutaurirana. Zvese zvakavharidzirwa kumagumo-kusvika-kumagumo.

featNoRegSub: Iyo app inogadzira ID yako otomatiki

Dzvanya pa "Dzvanya bhatani" kuti ugadzire chikwata.

Pane chishandiso chitsva, sarudza sarudzo yekudzoreredza pachiratidziro chekutanga uye pinda mutsara wako wekudzoreredza - kana zita reaccount yako uye passphrase. 3. Kana kuzivikanwa kwako kwadzoka, backup pane yako relay inowanikwa otomatiki uye inopihwa kudzoreredza. Hapana mapepa kana mapepa anodiwa.

toastRecoveryMismatch: Mutsara iwoyo uye passphrase hazvisi zveiyi Breeze ID — hapana chakadzoreredzwa.
toastRecoveryNoneKit: Ichi chiziviso chinoraswa (hapana kudzoreredza), saka kit yekudzoreredza haigone kugadzirwa.
simpleDesc: Yako yakavharidzirwa backup ichachengetwa pane relay iwe yaunomhanya kana chibvumirano — izvi hazvimbopihwa pane default relay. Pane chishandiso chitsva, zita reaccount yako + passphrase inounza iyo account yese kumashure, pasina chirevo chekunyora pasi. Iyo isina kusimba kupfuura mutsara wekudzoreredza: chero ani anomhanya iyo relay anobata iyo ciphertext uye anogona kuona kuti iyi account ine backup uye kana ichichinja, uye inofungidzirwa passphrase inoivhura. Iyo relay haigone kuiverenga — chete passphrase inogona. Sarudza imwe yakareba kwazvo.
simpleNewDesc: Sarudza zita rekudzoreredza account — senge email kero, uye iwe unofanirwa kuzvirangarira chaizvo — uye kudzoreredza passphrase yeinenge 8 mavara. Pamwe chete, ivo vanotora uye vhura yako backup pane chishandiso chitsva. Hapana anotumirwa kune relay; Izvo chete zvavanovhura ndizvo.
simpleSaved: Ini ndakawana zita rezita uye zita rezita
simpleAccountMin: Zita rekudzoreredza account rinofanira kunge riri 3 mavara (tsamba, nhamba, _ kana -).
simplePassMin: Kudzoreredza passphrase kunofanirwa kunge kuri 8 mavara.
simpleEnrolled: Kudzoreredza kuri nyore. Yako yakavharidzirwa backup inochengetwa pane yako relay.
simpleEnrolledUntil: Kudzoreredza kuri nyore. Iyo relay inochengeta iyo backup kusvika {0} — igadzirise kubva /backup isati yasvika.
simpleNotFound: Hapana backup yakawanikwa yeiyo account zita uye passphrase. Tarisa zvese zviri zviviri uye edza zvakare.
simpleNotEnrolled: Kudzoreredza kuri nyore hakuna kugadzirirwa kuzivikanwa uku.
simpleRestoreDesc: Pinda zita rekudzoreredza account uye passphrase yawakasarudza. Iyo backup inotorwa kubva kune ino relay uye yakavhurwa pane ino chishandiso chete.
simplePassChangeDesc: Iyi passphrase inotumidza yakasiyana backup slot pane iyo yako yazvino backup inogara mairi. Iyo yekare backup inogara pasi peiyo yekare passphrase kusvikira yapera (90 mazuva); Kudzoreredza kunoda chirevo chitsva. Ramba uchienderera chete kana shanduko iyi yaive nemaune.

migrateHtml:
Migrate from LINE / WhatsApp / Telegram
Step 1: Invite contacts (1-on-1)
Type /invite to copy an invite message → paste in LINE/WhatsApp
Type /qr to show a QR code → let them scan it
Step 1b: Move a whole group
Type /newgroup Your Group Name → generates an invite link
→ Paste the link in your LINE/WhatsApp group
→ Members just open the link to join automatically
Step 2: Import chat history
LINE: Chat → Settings → Send chat history → save .txt file
WhatsApp: Chat → More → Export chat → .txt
Telegram: Settings → Advanced → Export data → JSON
Type /import and select the file, or drag-drop onto the chat area
Step 3: Set up notifications
Allow browser notifications to get alerts for new messages
Add to Home Screen for an app-like experience

backupNudgeBody: Backup ndiyo chete nzira yekudzoka muaccount iyi kana iwe ukarasikirwa neichi chishandiso. Zvinongotora chinguva chishoma.

helpSetSaveDisplayName: Chengetedza zita rekuratidzira mumunda uye inogovera yako yakagadziridzwa nhoroondo nevashandi vane app inotsigira profiles. Zita racho rinobatsira vanhu kuti vakuzive; Icho hachisi chinhu chakasarudzika chinozivikanwa.
helpSetKtBlock: Inovharira chikamu chitsva chakavharidzirwa kana iyo kiyi-yekujekesa nhoroondo ichitaridzika yakashandurwa kana cheni yayo yakachengetwa isingaenderane. Izvi zvakachengeteka pane kungonyevera, asi zvinogona kukumisa iwe kutumira mameseji kudzamara shanduko yakakosha yasimbiswa kana kumisikidzwa kwadzimwa.
helpSetBackup: Inogadzira yakavharidzirwa backup pane yako relay kana backup yekuchengetera iripo. Iyo relay inochengeta chete ciphertext, asi kukanganwa passphrase zvinoreva kuti backup haigone kudzoreredzwa.
helpSetRestore: Tsvaga iyi account yakavharidzirwa backup pane yako yekumba relays uye inodzoreredza mushure mekuisa iyo inodiwa passphrase. Kudzoreredza kunotsiva data pane ichi chishandiso, saka chishandise nokungwarira.
helpSetAutoBackup: Inochengetedza otomatiki yakavharidzirwa backup mushure mekuchinja kwako kwedata. Iyo inomhanya chete mushure mekunge iwe wapinda iyo backup passphrase pane ichi chishandiso, uye chete kana yako relay ichipa backup yekuchengetedza.
helpSetAutobackupArm: Inokutendera iwe kuti upinde iyo backup passphrase kamwechete kuitira kuti otomatiki backups igone kumhanya panguva yechikamu ichi. Iyo passphrase inochengetwa chete mundangariro, saka ungangoda kuiisa zvakare mushure mekurodha zvakare app.
helpSetMigrateDevice: Inovhura nhanho-nhanho nhungamiro yekufambisa iyi account kune chimwe chishandiso uchishandisa yako yekudzoreredza mutsara kana account yekudzoreredza uye passphrase. Kuzivikanwa kwako hakusi kuteedzerwa kusvikira iwe wapedza matanho ekudzoreredza pane chishandiso chitsva.
helpSetHideRr: Rega kutumira marisiti ekuverenga kana iwe ukavhura imwe-kune-imwe chat. Vanotumira havazoone kana iwe uchiverenga mameseji avo; mameseji acho pachawo achiri kusvika zvakajairika.
helpSetHideTyping: Mira kutumira chiratidzo chekutaipa paunenge uchinyora. Vako vaunosangana navo havazoone kana iwe uchinyora mhinduro, asi iwe unogona achiri kuona yavo kana vakaigovana nayo.
helpSetRelayOnly: Inofambisa vezera-kune-vezera traffic kuburikidza nemaseva ekuendesa panzvimbo yekubatanidza zvakananga, kuvanza yako IP kero kubva kune vanobatana. Inogona kuita kufona uye kuendesa mafaera kunonoka kana kukundikana kana pasina relay inoshandiswa, uye iyo relay opareta inogona achiri kuona yekubatanidza metadata.
helpSetNotifSound: Inoridza ruzha rupfupi kana meseji kana kufona kunobvumidzwa kukuzivisa iwe kwasvika. Zviziviso zvekuona zvakaparadzaniswa, uye Focus mode kana hurukuro dzakanyarara dzinogona kunyaradza yambiro.
helpSetSendSound: Ita ruzha rupfupi kana iwe uchitumira meseji. Icho chinongova chisimbiso chemunharaunda uye hazvireve kuti mumwe munhu akagamuchira kana kuverenga.
helpSetTabVisCalls: Inoratidza kana kuvanza iyo Calls tebhu mune yepazasi tab bar. Kuviga hakubvisa nhoroondo yekufona kana kudzima kufona.
helpSetTabVisContacts: Inoratidza kana kuvanza iyo Contacts tebhu mune yepazasi tab bar. Kuviga hakubvisa vashandi vako kana chats.
helpSetTabVisSelf: Inoratidza kana kuvanza iyo Profile tebhu mune yepazasi tab bar. Nhoroondo yako inoramba iripo, uye izvi hazvishandure kana yakagovaniswa.
helpSetTabVisSettings: Inoratidza kana kuvanza iyo Zvirongwa tebhu mune yepazasi tab bar. Kana iwe ukaivanza uchishandisa Zvirongwa, Breeze inodzokera kuChats; Zvirongwa zvinoramba zvichiwanikwa kubva kubhatani rekumisikidza kana mirairo.
helpSetCallHistoryLog: Inochengeta runyorwa rwemunharaunda rwekubuda, kuuya, uye kupotsa mafoni pane ichi chishandiso. Dzvanya pano kuti umise kufona kutsva; Izvo hazvibvise nhoroondo yakatochengetedzwa.
helpSetAutoLock: Kana iyo app-kukiya password yakaiswa, kiya Breeze kana iwe uchichinja kubva patebhu yayo. Iwe uchazoda password iyoyo paunodzoka; Izvi hazvitsive kuvhara chishandiso pachacho.
helpSetNotifPerm: Kumbira bhurawuza kana sisitimu yekushandisa mvumo yekuratidza zviziviso. Breeze haigoni kupa izvi pachayo; Kana mvumo yakarambwa kare, ungangoda kuishandura mubrowser kana system marongero.
helpSetShowPeerName: Inoratidza zita remunhu akazvisarudzira padivi pezita remadunhurirwa rawakavapa. Izvi zvinongoshandura izvo zvaunoona munharaunda; Hapana chinowedzerwa chinotumirwa kune kutaurirana kana kudzokorora.
helpSetAddRelay: Inowedzera imwe relay yekumba mushure mekuratidzira chigunwe chayo chekusimbisa. Mamwe epamba relays anogona kuvandudza kuwanikwa, asi yega yega inogona kuona metadata senge riini uye kuti yakawanda sei yakavharidzirwa traffic inopfuura nayo.
helpSetRemoveRelay: Bvisa imwe yakawedzerwa imba relay kubva pane ino runyorwa rwechishandiso. Iyo relay inochengeta ciphertext iyo yatove yakagamuchira kusvika yakajairika kupera; kubviswa kunongomisa makopi emangwana kubva pakushandisa iyo relay.
helpSetFanout: Kune vanobatana vanoshandisa akawanda epamba relays, inotumira yega yega meseji kopi kune iyi yakawanda yeaya relays. Mamwe makopi anogona kuvandudza kuendesa kana imwe relay iri pasi, asi ivo vanoshandisa yakawanda network traffic uye vanochengeta ciphertext munzvimbo dzakawanda.
helpSetPowerMode: Inodzora kuti yakawanda sei Breeze inoderedza kumashure kutarisa kuchengetedza bhatiri. Kutumira hakuna kunonoka, asi Saver uye Emergency inogona kuita kuti mameseji anouya uye kuvepo kwekuvandudza kusvika gare gare; Auto inoteedzera bhatiri rako kana bhurawuza racho richitaura.
helpSetRrDelay: Mirira anenge maminetsi maviri, nemusiyano mudiki usina kujairika, usati watumira risiti yekuverenga. Izvi zvinoita kuti nguva yako chaiyo yekuverenga ive isinganyatsojeke, asi vanotumira vachiri pakupedzisira kudzidza kuti meseji yakaverengwa.
helpSetFocus: Dzvanya pano kuti uone kuti ndeapi maawa mashomanana. Mazhinji mameseji anonyeverwa akanyarara paanenge aripo; VIP kutaurirana uye kutaurwa kunogona kukunyevera iwe kunze kwekunge yakasimba modhi iripo.
helpSetFocusStrict: Bvisa iyo VIP uye taura kusarudzika muFocus mode, saka meseji yambiro inogara yakanyarara kune wese munhu. Ruzha rwemhete dzinouya dzinodzvinyirirwa zvakare, kunyangwe yako system ichiri kuratidza chiziviso chinoonekwa.
helpSetRestoreFile: Dzoreredza yakavharidzirwa backup kubva kune faira rawakachengeta kare. Iwe unoda iyo backup passphrase, uye iyo yakadzoreredzwa data inotsiva izvo zviri pane ichi chishandiso.
helpSetInviteFriend: Gadzira chinongedzo kana meseji mumwe munhu anogona kushandisa kuti akuwedzera iwe paBreeze. Chero ani zvake ane chinongedzo anogona kuishandisa, saka goverana chete nemunhu waunoda kukoka.
helpSetMigrateApps: Inovhura gwara rekufambisa vanobatana kana mapoka kubva kuLINE, WhatsApp, kana Teregiramu kuenda kuBreeze, kusanganisira sarudzo yekukurukurirana-nhoroondo kupinza. Nhoroondo yakatumirwa kunze kwenyika inongosanganisira chete izvo imwe app yakatumirwa kunze kwenyika.
cfStatusSaved: Token yakachengetwa pane ichi chishandiso, asi haisati yasimbiswa.
cfStatusConnectedNoAccounts: Token yakasimbiswa. Token chinzvimbo: {0}; Hapana nhoroondo inoonekwa kune ichi chiratidzo.
cfErrNoProxy: Cloudflare setup inoda yakagadziriswa Breeze relay yeiyo API proxy. Wedzera imba relay kutanga, kana kuzvidzora Breeze uye kumhanya setup ipapo.
cfErrStorage: Iko hakuna kukwanisa kumisikidza chishandiso chekuchengetera
cfSaved: Cloudflare token yakachengetwa pane ino chishandiso.
cfDisconnected: Cloudflare yekubatanidza yakabviswa kubva pane ino chishandiso.
cfNote: Ichi chishandiso chinongochengetwa chete pane ino chishandiso. Browser zvikumbiro zvinopfuura zvisina maturo kuburikidza neiyi /api / cf-proxy kune Cloudflare's API pasina kurongedzwa kana kuchengetwa. Verified relays ine relay kiyi inowedzerwa kuHome Relays otomatiki.
helpSetCloudflareSave: Inochengeta iyo Cloudflare API tokeni chete mune ino chishandiso IndexedDB marongero chitoro. Iyo inotumirwa chete kuCloudflare's API sechiratidzo cheBearer, kwete kuBreeze relays. Server setup inoda chiratidzo chine account kuverenga (rondedzero maakaundi), Vashandi Scripts edit, uye Vashandi KV Storage edit mvumo.
helpSetCloudflareVerify: Inoshevedza Cloudflare's token yekusimbisa uye account runyorwa APIs nechiratidzo chakachengetwa pane ichi chishandiso, wobva waratidza iyo chaiyo chiratidzo chinzvimbo uye mazita eakaundi kana iko kukanganisa chaiko. Ichi chishandiso chinongotumirwa chete kuCloudflare API. Server setup inoda account kuverenga (rondedzero account), Vashandi Scripts edit, uye Vashandi KV Storage edit mvumo.
helpSetCloudflareDisconnect: Inobvisa iyo yakachengetwa Cloudflare API token kubva kune ino chishandiso IndexedDB marongero chitoro uye inojekesa iyo yakaratidzwa yekubatanidza mamiriro. helpSetCloudflareSetup: Inogadzira kana kushandisa zvakare iyo breeze-kuvapo KV namespace, inoisa iyo bundled Breeze Worker seiyo breeze script ine inodiwa KV kusungwa, inogonesa kero yayo workers.dev, uye inotarisa /api / hutano. Iyo tokeni inoda account kuverenga (rondedzero account), Vashandi Scripts edit, uye Vashandi KV Storage edit. Iyo server URL inochengetwa pane ichi chishandiso chete; Wedzera iyo semusha wekudzoreredza kubva kuRelays kana iwe uchida kuishandisa. Kumisikidza hakugadzirise zvakavanzika zvekusundira zviziviso, TURN, kana iyo relay kuzivikanwa kiyi, saka iwo maficha anogara kure kana mune yavo default fallback kudzamara yagadziriswa muCloudflare dashboard.
